title: Usage report operator mapping, version 1
description: Structure of an operator-owned mapping stored outside the repository. The usage-report parser also enforces the 64 KiB file limit, external real path, known Worker names, unique Worker rows, alias uniqueness across rows, and UTF-8 byte limits.

worker.description: An exact Worker name in the current checked-in configuration inventory. The parser enforces inventory membership and one row per Worker.

deployments.description: Historical metric deployment labels declared by the operator for this Worker. A label cannot belong to more than one Worker row.

items.description: At most 128 UTF-8 bytes. The character limit here is necessary but insufficient; the parser enforces the byte limit.
